feasibility_probe.lesson: Rooms close on this drawing once (a) walls, columns, glazing and negatives have role authority and (b) door swings close their openings. Both must come from EVIDENCE the engine computes, not from a layer map.

1_blockers_solvable_by_engine_improvemen: B-ROLE: no role authority for numeric / single-letter layers (1, 2, 4, 5, W, D, CC). Solvable by a generic ENTITY_ROLE_INFERENCE engine that scores geometry + CAD-structure + context evidence per layer and per part, and emits source-scoped POLICY_ACCEPTED claims (never REVIEWED, never transferred).

B-DOOR: door occurrences are recognised only by a DOOR layer / block NAME. Solvable: a door MOTIF (one swing < pi + a straight leaf ~= radius from the hinge, hinge anchored on an accepted wall face / band end) yields an inferred door-occurrence claim that geometry_role admits as OPENING_SYMBOL (new optional input, default empty -> Qortuba unchanged).

B-FRAME: sheet frames are closed polylines on the wall layer. Solvable: repeated identical closed rectangles enclosing a whole drawing cluster + a title-text band -> part-scoped SHEET_FRAME claims; plan region = frame interior.

B-UNREAL: 3 RTEXT plot stamps reach the topology with layer None and block every site (UNREALISED_ENTITY_LAYER_UNKNOWN). Solvable: read the RTEXT layer and its proxy-graphics placement from the raw DXF (generic proxy-graphic vertex decode) so the frozen accounting can locate it by PLACEMENT.

B-WINDOW: window multi-lines share the plot-boundary layer. Solvable: a window-in-gap motif (2-4 parallel short segments spanning a wall-band gap, inside the band thickness) -> part-scoped GLAZING_BOUNDARY claims; the remaining long lines of that layer get a PLOT/SITE negative role only if they lie outside every wall band and enclose the building.
B-COLUMN: column outlines are small closed rectangles with a SOLID fill. Solvable: closed rectangle + fill motif + contact with wall bands -> STRUCTURAL_OBSTACLE claims.

B-NEG: overhead / centre lines are distinguishable by LINETYPE (HIDDEN, CENTER), level / stair-arrow / text-leader linework by its association with text and symbol inserts. Solvable as negative-role evidence.

B-FOOT: 8 footing occurrences failed tag association. Partly solvable by constraint-unique matching (schedule size + orientation + rotation + clipping + grid position + uniqueness); anything not unique stays BLOCKED.

3_generic_topology_strategy: Layer names carry NO authority. Per effective layer and per part the engine computes OBSERVATIONS: linetype and lineweight, entity type mix, block-occurrence share, parallel-pair share and the pair-offset distribution in mm, collinear-band share, endpoint join / T-junction share, closed-rectangle share (and fill association), closure contribution to label-bearing cycles, distance to door hinges / window motifs, position relative to the detected plan region and frame. A ROLE_CANDIDATE is scored from at least two independent evidence channels; a candidate becomes a CLAIM only when its score clears the frozen threshold AND no competing candidate is within the frozen margin; mixed layers are decided per PART (part-scoped claims) or left UNKNOWN (which then blocks exactly the sites it separates). Claims are POLICY_ACCEPTED, source-scoped (revision id + anchor hash + region), versioned, and never applied to another source.

4_how_evidence_combines.WALL_FACE: paired parallel continuous lines at a wall-thickness offset (80-400 mm) over most of their length + T / L joins + participation in closed cycles that hold room labels + door hinges / window motifs anchored on them. A single-line layer or a layer whose pairs sit at furniture offsets fails.
4_how_evidence_combines.DOOR: existence = a physical opening (a wall-band gap) + a door-symbol motif (one swing arc < pi, a leaf line from the hinge of length ~= radius, hinge within the band thickness of a gap jamb). Width = the swing radius (source geometry) cross-checked against the gap width. No door layer or block name is required; a name only corroborates.
4_how_evidence_combines.WINDOW: existence = a wall-band gap closed by 2-4 parallel lines inside the band thickness, spanning the gap; NO swing. Geometry = gap width + band thickness. Height / sill = vertical evidence only (elevation transcription), else BLOCKED_HEIGHT. Material = BLOCKED.
4_how_evidence_combines.COLUMN: small closed rectangle (or circle) with a fill and contact with wall bands, repeated at grid positions; corroborated by the structural column plan footprint where both exist.
4_how_evidence_combines.NEGATIVES: sheet frame (repeated identical closed rectangles bounding a drawing cluster), title block (text-dense band inside the frame), plot boundary (long lines enclosing every wall band, outside all bands), dimension (DIMENSION entities and their layers), hatch, grid / centre lines (CENTER linetype + grid bubbles), overhead (HIDDEN linetype), furniture / fixtures (closed symbol occurrences without boundary content), annotation (text-associated short linework, level marks, stair arrows).
4_how_evidence_combines.TEXT: room labels are semantic only and are attached AFTER a site exists; level marks are vertical evidence; dimensions corroborate widths.

7_pdf_only_sheets: OpenTakeoff-style help = SHEET CLASSIFICATION + localisation, not measurement: per page, record kind (area plan / elevation / section / fence detail), title text as transcribed, the views it shows, and the CAD sheet it corresponds to (if any). The raster pages have no text layer and no authorised scale; no pixel is measured. They contribute vertical EVIDENCE items (level marks, parapet marks, opening head / sill marks where printed) with page, crop box, transcription and confidence.
8_raster_sections_as_vertical_evidence: Each transcribed mark becomes a VERTICAL_EVIDENCE item {page, crop (pixel box), transcription, kind (FFL / roof / parapet / window head / sill / door head / beam soffit), floor, confidence, corroboration with CAD level marks}. A floor-to-floor or floor-to-soffit HEIGHT is computed only from two transcribed level values on the same section (difference of printed values, never pixels) and is published as EVIDENCE (SHADOW), never as a global height; a wall-face area may use it only where it is proven for that floor and the gate says so.
9_role_inference_architecture: engine/source/entity_role_inference.py (ENTITY_ROLE_INFERENCE_V1, stdlib, project-agnostic): observe(input) -> OBSERVATIONS per layer / part / occurrence; candidates(observations) -> ROLE_CANDIDATES with per-channel scores and reasons; decide(candidates, policy) -> ACCEPTED claims | BLOCKED (with the competing candidates); claims are role_authority.SourceLayerRoleClaim with review_state POLICY_ACCEPTED and authority ENTITY_ROLE_INFERENCE_V1 (role_authority.claim_applies honours that state only with that authority and non-empty evidence). Inferred door occurrences are a separate output passed to room_topology.run(inferred_door_occurrences=...). Region detection (frames, plan regions, floor assignment from title text) is a separate generic function. Nothing in it names a layer, handle, coordinate or project.
10_structural_expansion: footings: constraint-unique tag -> outline matching for the 8 orphan tags; rotated / clipped outlines measured on their own axes; a match counts only if it is the UNIQUE outline consistent with the schedule size and the tag
columns: occurrence register from the column plan (tag + outline), section from the schedule, plan area; count and section COMPUTED; volume BLOCKED_HEIGHT (no founding / slab levels)

beams: schedule widths and depths per type; plan lengths only where a tagged beam band is unambiguous between supports; volume only where width + depth + length are all proven; ambiguous occurrences BLOCKED

slabs: outline per slab plan, thickness from the slab label; volume only where the outline closes and the thickness is unique; beam / slab overlap deducted once (beam depth below slab) or the row is BLOCKED
rebar: REBAR_EVIDENCE completeness per element (bar marks, diameters, spacings found vs lengths / laps / counts missing); tonnage stays BLOCKED
11_stays_blocked: wall / ceiling heights not proven per floor
stair finishes and railings beyond counted geometry

13_disagreements: 'Certify real rooms': rooms whose roles rest on POLICY_ACCEPTED inference are certified as SHADOW geometry with role authority recorded as INFERRED; they are not human-reviewed and the units are still PROVISIONAL, so nothing here is a release quantity.

Wall-face area and blockwork AREA need a height per floor; the source set has only raster level marks. Lengths and thicknesses are published; areas stay BLOCKED_HEIGHT unless the per-floor height gate passes.
Wet-room semantics: sanitary fixture symbols + a wet-room label corroborate a WET classification; waterproofing material stays blocked.
Mixed layers (counters, stairs, plot lines and drains on one layer) are decided per part or left UNKNOWN; a site they separate stays REVIEW_REQUIRED rather than being forced closed.
